Hi Tom — great to connect. Short answer: yes, we can present both a pilot SKU and an amortized 12-month option. Attached is a starter-kit pricing workbook that shows two scenarios (pilot: 3 months, and commit: 12 months). Highlights are below. Attached: Nexera_StarterKit_Pricing.xlsx (xlsx)

Pilot (3 months) — conservative starter kit
- Dedicated nodes: 2 c6g-style nodes (GPU equivalent) — metered by node-hour
- Platform fee: one-time pilot platform fee $25k (covers private control plane, initial KV caching config & baseline telemetry)
- Support: Silver (business hours) included, can add Premium on-call at +$6k/mo
- Migration credit: 40 hours of onboarding engineering (one-time)

12-month commit — amortized approach
- Platform fee: we can amortize the pilot platform fee across the first 12 months if you convert to a 12-month reserved capacity within 30 days of pilot completion. Option A: convert $25k into a $2,083/mo credit; Option B: roll into a service retainer (prepaid) that lowers per-token rates by ~12%.
- Support ladder: Premium on-call included at tier levels for >QPS threshold; see attached support ladder.

Next steps I propose: 1) quick sync with finance to confirm amortization mechanics (cc'ing Vanessa and Marissa), 2) I’ll draft the SOW addendum for the migration hours and support. Are you available for a 30-min call tomorrow at 11am PT?

Tom — quick clarifications from the commercial side (attaching support ladder PDF). Attached: Redwood_Support_Ladders.pdf (pdf)

- The $25k pilot platform fee is designed to cover private control plane provisioning, a baseline model/ops tuning pass, and a short-term cache warmup budget. If you prefer, we can alternatively show this as a prepaid retainer and apply it as a monthly credit against usage for the first 6 months.
- For a 12-month reserved commitment (12x nodes), we can offer: 10% discount on node-hours, waive the first month of the platform fee, and include Premium support during the first 90 days.
